mapper.select: SELECT * FROM recruitment_notice WHERE source_id=#{sourceId} AND notice_url=#{noticeUrl}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recruitment_notice n JOIN recruitment_source s ON s.id=n.source_id

SELECT n.id,n.title,n.notice_url AS noticeUrl,n.publish_date AS publishDate,n.notice_type AS noticeType,n.user_status AS userStatus,n.detail_status AS detailStatus,n.detail_fetched_at AS detailFetchedAt,n.detail_error AS detailError,n.viewed_at AS viewedAt,n.discovered_at AS discoveredAt,s.source_code AS sourceCode,s.source_name AS sourceName FROM recruitment_notice n JOIN recruitment_source s ON s.id=n.source_id ORDER BY n.publish_date DESC,n.discovered_at DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{size}

SELECT n.id,n.title,n.notice_url AS noticeUrl,n.publish_date AS publishDate,n.notice_type AS noticeType,n.user_status AS userStatus,n.detail_status AS detailStatus,n.body_html AS bodyHtml,n.body_text AS bodyText,n.detail_fetched_at AS detailFetchedAt,n.detail_error AS detailError,n.viewed_at AS viewedAt,n.discovered_at AS discoveredAt,s.source_code AS sourceCode,s.source_name AS sourceName FROM recruitment_notice n JOIN recruitment_source s ON s.id=n.source_id WHERE n.id=#{id}
